evidence_quotes.name_asked_and_used: Roselyn: 'I'm looking to speak with Andrea.' Andrea: 'Yes, this is.' Then used repeatedly throughout the call.
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Roselyn: 'this would take about ten to fifteen minutes of your time. So you can walk away with a code you can depend on instead of just having a gas. Does that sounds good to you?' Andrea: 'Yes, go ahead.'
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Roselyn: 'We talk a lot of people everyday, most of them have one or two concerns either mover is not showing up on time or damage their items are either of those a concern for you.' — Asked after logistics probing had already begun.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Andrea raises damage concern: 'making sure nothing's damaged.' Roselyn reflects back but does not probe deeper with 'tell me more' or sustained follow-up.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: Roselyn: 'So what I'm hearing is your concern with regards to not damaging the items. Did I get it? Okay, perfect!'
evidence_quotes.promises_delivered: No promises about On-Time Guarantee or No Worries Damage Coverage were delivered. Routed directly to virtual walkthrough instead.
evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening_and_logistics: Roselyn asks about additional rooms, parking, box count, packing needs, access concerns, and tree clearance. Logistics fully covered despite no explicit 'What items are you most concerned about?' opening.
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Box count: 'typical backs count based on your home size is between $180 to $200 do you feel that you fall within that range?' Customer clarified 50 boxes. Packing: 'do you need help in packing like putting the small items into your boxes?' Customer: kitchen only.

top_strength: Rep smoothly gathered all logistics details (property specs, parking, access concerns, box count, packing needs) and cleanly routed to virtual walkthrough with a confirmed link and clear next steps.
coaching_note: Deliver both promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) before routing to walkthrough — they belong in step 3 on the v4 card, after concerns are raised but before the walkthrough decision, and this customer's damage concern made them especially relevant to address.
